[LSCP.1.7] `ambient` is a permissions modifier on a base lifecycle
([LSCP.1.5]), not a standalone scope value ([LSCP.2.5]). The compiler
must reject the bare form `schema Foo scope ambient:` with
`DS_VALIDATE_BARE_AMBIENT_SCOPE_RETIRED`, naming the schema and
suggesting the base-lifecycle spelling — a `logical`-based schema, so
every slot takes a `key` / `mutable` marker ([LGRA.5.10]).
